title: Radar Detection Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Radar_Detection_Generator.md
text: 根据雷达测量创建检测对象，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Length of actors cuboids (m)} 指定长方体长度；{Unique identifier of sensor} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Required interval between sensor updates (s)} 指定所需时间间隔、{Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)} 指定雷达传感器中心的位置、{Sensor’s height (m)} 指定雷达传感器离地平面的高度、{Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的偏航角、{Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的俯仰角、{Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的横滚角、{Source of output bus name} 输出总线名称的来源、{Specify an output bus name} 输出总线名称 no default、{Maximum number of reported detections} 指定报告的最大检测数、{Coordinate system used to report detections} 指定报告的检测的坐标系 Ego、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted、{Azimuthal resolution of radar (deg)} 指定雷达方位角分辨率、{Elevation resolution of radar (deg)} 指定雷达仰角分辨率、{Range resolution of radar (m)} 指定雷达距离分辨率、{Range rate resolution of radar (m/s)} 指定雷达的距离变化率分辨率、{Fractional azimuthal bias component of radar} 指定方位角偏差比例、{Fractional elevation bias component of radar} 指定仰角偏差比例、{Fractional range bias component of radar} 指定距离偏差比例、{Fractional range rate bias component of radar} 指定雷达的距离变化率偏差比例、{Total angular field of view for radar (deg)} 指定雷达传感器的视场、{Maximum detection range (m)} 指定最大检测范围、{Minimum and maximum range rates that can be reported} 指定最小和最大检测距离变化率、{Detection probability} 指定检测目标的概率、{Rate at which false alarms are reported} 指定虚警率 1e-6、{Range where detection probability is achieved (m):} 指定给定检测概率下的参考距离、{Radar cross section at which detection probability is achieved (dBsm)} 指定给定检测概率下的参考雷达截面积、{Enable elevation angle measurements} 启用雷达测量仰角、{Enable range rate measurements} 启用雷达测量距离变化率、{Add noise to measurements} 启用向雷达传感器测量添加噪声、{Enable false detections} 启用创建雷达虚警检测、{Enable occlusion} 启用视线遮挡、{Select method to specify initial seed} 指定随机数生成器种子的方法、{Initial seed} 指定随机数生成器种子、{Select method to specify actor profiles} 指定参与者配置文件的方法 From Scenario Reader、{MATLAB expression for actor profiles}、{Unique identifier for actors} 指定场景定义的目标物标识符、{User-defined integer to classify actors} 指定用户定义的分类标识符、{Width of actors cuboids (m)} 指定长方体宽度、{Height of actors cuboids (m)} 指定长方体高度、{Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)} 指定 actor 的旋转中心、{Radar cross section pattern (dBsm)} 指定雷达截面积、{Azimuth angles defining RCSPattern (deg)} 指定雷达截面积方向图的方位角、{Elevation angles defining RCSPattern (deg)} 指定雷达截面积方向图的仰角，按实例取值。
